steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Mudrock, they're hunting down the last fugitives.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They could have just left the fugitives to fend for themselves in the mountains. Capturing them will save their lives.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I can't tell if they're being cruel or kind.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: The ones who didn't follow us are not our problem, but...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Try to avoid the search parties. We need to get out of here before winter.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It's already cold.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: And go where?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We've been wandering for so long. Where does it end? It definitely won't end well.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Then, let's go home.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We go back and find a quiet patch of woods. And we survive.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: What about our fight?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: For now... we live.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: To live, just to live, we are fighting the world every day.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: We're going home? To what home?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Kazdel.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Huh...

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: But what about us? We're not Sarkaz. That's...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You are companions of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: There may be no place for Sarkaz outside of Kazdel. But in Kazdel, there is a place for you.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Not because of tolerance. But because there is... nothing there.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Kazdel... is not a city. Not a country. Technically, it is just a region.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: A land of exiles where we are not allowed to build homes.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Kazdel... is where the homeless go. A land of rootless people.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It is where you belong.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Maybe we can live in peace in Kazdel. It's full of Infected Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Leithanien's leniency toward the Infected is ultimately just a product of the popularity of bloodlines and Originium Arts. It doesn't mean they truly accept you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: As soon as the mask came off, the very first to be ostracized were still the Infected.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: It's not just Oripathy. This rich country has forgotten all the depressed corners of our world.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: A tragedy like Wolumonde's is just a mild annoyance for the aristocrats. It's a topic of conversation for the bankers and court artists at tea time.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: We can't accept it. We won't.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: So we leave. We'll go to Kazdel. Let's see your hometown.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Will Leithanien come after us?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Maybe. Regardless of what happened before, a group of Infected Sarkaz showed up and destroyed a town. Piss-poor optics.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Severin knows the truth. Would he try to frame us?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: He would.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: It's just the way he does things. Based on the information he has, he will do what causes the least amount of damage to his town.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Then we have to get out of here quickly, or all of Leithanien is going to come down on us.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Yes. So we must figure out a route soon... Oh...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Sorry. Wait a moment. I have to go somewhere.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Very quick.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: So that's where you were.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Operator Folinic.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No, don't get up. I won't get too close to you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You're waiting for someone, aren't you?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I wasn't on the Rhodes Island landship when the Reunion incident happened. You... changed a lot.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You're very different from what the rumors say about you.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Rumors?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I heard you fought alongside an elite operator to solve a lot of the problems in Lungmen.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: ...a big, dumb, reckless cat who gets blood everywhere.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: And we weren't able to solve... anything.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...Thank you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I have to thank you again. I don't know how things would have turned out without you and Lisa.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Rhodes Island, Severin, even Reunion. No one wanted it to come to this.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Everyone was fighting to stop the tragedy, but we were powerless.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Atro, she...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Don't push yourself to mourn anything or anyone. It's over now.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Just pray for the dead to rest in peace.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We failed to bring the killer to justice. Not only that, we failed to protect the town Atro gave her life for.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: She would have blamed me, wouldn't she?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Only you would blame yourself. Atro was a cheerful, open-minded woman.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: She would slap you on the shoulder and get drunk with you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Heh... you're right. Seems like you knew her well?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I know a certain 'elite operator' she liked to get drunk with.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: We're not the only ones who have given up on chasing all this.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You came.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Here, freshly picked wildflowers...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You should be aware of the situation at hand. The cleanup mission is nearing completion and Rhodes Island will be leaving the area soon to try to contact Resource Dispatch for assistance.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: But when that happens...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No one will speak for us. I know.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I don't blame Severin. This is the only thing he can tell the nobles, or his people will be the ones to suffer.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We too will leave here soon. It's just that, some of our people died here... I don't want to leave without saying goodbye.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...Eight Infected.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But not, the number of casualties in Wolumonde is hundreds of times greater than that.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No... it's not your fault. I wasn't blaming you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm just reflecting on it. Thinking about how it came to this.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Of course, I know the world is not fair. Good things don't come to good people. But also... rarely have I ever seen such self-destructiveness.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Fomented anger and lust for revenge nearly destroyed everything... even me.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You're still blaming yourself.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No... I've calmed down past that. I'm only reevaluating, maybe what I thought was 'done wrong' just 'couldn't be done.'

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Everything from Rhodes Island, everything Dr. Kal'tsit taught me... I just couldn't do it.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No one could.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I stopped them from crossing the line, but one or two stops can't quench their vengeful rage.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: So... things are the way they are.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: What are you going to do next? 'Reunion' is still a big problem for many people. You should let go of that symbol.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: You're right. But 'Reunion' is not dead. And this news has spread among the Infected in Leithanien.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: The fire of resistance continues to burn... twisted and distorted as it is. We must take a moment to catch our breaths.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: There are too many in my squad with no combat experience. I can't decide their fate. They... perhaps they just want to live in peace.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Say... Rhodes Island, have you ever heard the name 'Big Bob?'

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If there's a connection, I could search the archives.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No. There isn't. He's just a friend of mine...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Reunion? Or Sarkaz?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Reunion. He is an experienced bounty hunter.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: They are not warriors, so they had a reason to get out... They should free themselves from oppression and seek a place for themselves among the Columbian pioneers.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Ah, come to think of it, they have hops.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Have you ever seen hops? How does it work? You crush it up into beer?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Um, it's a fine plant... it has something to do with the beer foam. Um, I think it prolongs the antiseptic—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No. I don't really have to explain this, do I? I'm not that familiar with it.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Let's just say, it's very handy.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I see. Lucky.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Hops... foam... beer...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Hey, don't get lost thinking about beer. We're still enemies here.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: We may never be able to bridge our differences.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Oh... sorry.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We are warriors. Sarkaz are warriors.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I have to say... it's hard to feel your warrior spirit from your words and actions.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We had no choice.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: If we have any demands, any convictions, anything to protect, we can only fight.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: There are other ways to solve problems.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Then... what of our fallen companions? If we stand peacefully, will the murderers open their homes and cities to us?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: They won't.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We can only fight on... to help our fellow Infected.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: 'Our fellow Infected.'

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Kazdel.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Kazdel is not a good place.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: We're not good guys, Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Any real 'good place' is closed to us.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You have another choice, Mudrock.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No. Not now.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: These Leithanians, these Sarkaz, they all have their own ideas.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: The resentment is still there. Nothing has made it easier to trust each other. Only the will to live as one ever held them all together. That was the only bond.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: How sad.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: No, Rhodes Island Swallow. Maybe we'll see each other again someday... to fight for the Infected.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You're not the first one from Reunion to call me that.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Is that so...

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: After I leave here, we are, as before, enemies.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Otherwise, Leithanien will suspect you. And you won't have an explanation.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: So... don't get too close to your enemy.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: I came only to offer a bouquet. And I did. So... it's time to go.

steps.name: Mudrock
steps.text: Good luck.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: If you have anything else to say, now is the time.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I don't.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I feel like I've been living a nightmare. And watching him walk away, it's like finally waking up.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's... over.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I'm not very good at comforting people, but—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I know you're not the one who should be comforting me. Sorry.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: We just have to let go of the grief. It's not a good thing. It's a compromise that lets us keep living.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: How long did it take you to come to terms with it?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: A long time. Long enough to lose even more.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: What now?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We go back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We... take Atro home.
